NVMI optional conditional common allocation
NVMI 可选条件普通股价值分配

Method v1 · capital origin December 31, 2025 · information through October 18, 2026. This additive analyst estimate preserves the dated operating-EV model and all original source studies. It is neither observed instrument fair value nor a current price target or contemporaneous December backtest.

方法第1版 · 资本基准日2025年12月31日 · 信息截至2026年10月18日。此附加分析师估计保留原有营业企业价值模型和原始研究，既不是观察到的金融工具公允价值，也不是当前目标价或当时可知信息的12月回测。

Allocation / 分配

All aggregate values are USD millions, share quantities millions. Assets A = operating EV + eligible liquid assets − operating cash reserve − separately deducted opening claims − additional residual allowance. Solve (N + aR)S + O(S) + Vcb(S) − G(S) = A. Existing common equity is N×S; legacy RSU claim is aR×S. N is the capital-date common share count, not diluted weighted-average EPS shares.

金额单位均为百万美元，股数单位为百万股。资产A＝营业企业价值＋合格流动资产−营业现金储备−单独扣除的期初索偿−额外剩余索偿预留。求解 (N＋aR)S＋O(S)＋Vcb(S)−G(S)＝A。现有普通股权益为N×S，存量受限股单位索偿为aR×S。N使用资本基准日普通股数，并非每股收益的加权平均稀释股数。

Vcb = discounted zero-coupon principal + initial underlying shares × average discounted daily conversion calls + mismatch allowance. G = (1 − haircut) × underlying shares × average discounted daily call spreads. Each of 40 observations has its own clipped payoff; this is not a call on an average stock price. Observations use T − (41 − j)/252 for j = 0…39; payments use the common maturity September 15, 2030. European calls use Black–Scholes, with the analytic deterministic limit at zero volatility. Employee options use four reported weighted-average strike/life buckets; no early exercise and no tax shield are assumed.

Vcb＝折现零息本金＋初始对应股数×每日转换看涨期权的折现平均值＋不匹配预留。G＝（1−折减）×对应股数×每日看涨期权价差的折现平均值。40个观察日分别计算有上限收益，并非对平均股价计算期权。观察日为T−(41−j)/252，j＝0…39；统一按2030年9月15日到期付款。欧式期权使用布莱克–斯科尔斯模型，零波动率使用确定性解析极限。员工期权使用披露的四组加权平均执行价／剩余期限，假定无提前行权且不计税盾。

Dynamic bracketing and bisection solve the allocation without a target price. If senior claims exhaust assets at S=0, no positive solution is reported. This is not a bankruptcy recovery model. Full numerical precision is retained in calculations and exports; the interface shows at most two decimal places.

动态区间和二分法求解，不设目标股价。若S＝0时优先索偿已耗尽资产，则报告无正解。这不是破产回收模型。计算及导出保留完整数值精度，界面最多显示两位小数。

Assumptions and limitations / 假设与局限

The 50.08% equity volatility is a January 2026 US semiconductor-equipment sector proxy, not measured NVMI implied volatility. The flat continuously compounded rate is transformed from a December five-year Treasury par yield of 3.73%, not a bootstrapped zero curve. The 150 bp credit spread, one-for-one RSU payout, zero hedge haircut and $5m residual are analyst choices. RSU multipliers are not contractual payout bounds. Future compensation remains in operating cash flows.

50.08%股权波动率来自2026年1月美国半导体设备行业代理数据，并非实测NVMI隐含波动率。连续复利平坦利率由12月五年期美国国债3.73%票面收益率转换，并非引导得出的零息曲线。150基点信用利差、受限股单位一比一支付、零对冲折减及500万美元剩余索偿均为分析师选择。受限股单位倍数并非合约支付边界。未来薪酬保留在营业现金流中。

The convertible is a no-early-event matched-strip surrogate, not a contract-complete valuation. It omits holder conversion eligibility/choice, issuer soft calls, make-whole increases, fundamental-change puts, early hedge termination, corporate adjustments, dealer default and joint equity/default recovery dynamics. Principal survival plus daily positive upside is not an exact replication of every cash/share/combination settlement election. The executed indenture starts conditional issuer redemption September 20, 2028; the annual report also mentions October 20. The executed contract controls; this source discrepancy is not modeled by the no-early-event proxy.

可转债采用无提前事件的匹配期权条带近似，并非完整合约估值。未建模持有人转换资格及选择、发行人有条件赎回、补偿性增股、重大变化回售、对冲提前终止、公司行为调整、交易对手违约及股权／违约回收联动。本金存续加每日正收益不能精确复制全部现金／股票／组合结算选择。已执行契约规定有条件赎回自2028年9月20日开始；年报另有10月20日表述。以已执行契约为准，此来源差异未在无提前事件模型中建模。

Matched strike legs cancel only algebraically under this surrogate. Do not add note-underlying shares to the denominator, deduct principal or RSUs again, add exercise proceeds again, or credit the historical hedge premium. The face-bond, no-hedge and extra $25m mismatch diagnostics are selected model-choice illustrations, not confidence intervals or worst-case bounds. Higher spread releases common value while holding EV fixed; it is not a complete distress scenario.

匹配执行价期权仅在近似模型中代数抵消。不要将可转债对应股数增加至分母、重复扣除本金或受限股单位、重复增加行权收入或计入历史对冲权利金。债务面值、不计对冲及额外2500万美元不匹配诊断只是选定模型假设示例，不是置信区间或最坏情况边界。固定企业价值时更高利差释放普通股价值，并非完整困境情景。

Separate reference and simulation / 独立参考与模拟

The fixed-market reference retains the full observed December convertible quote of $936.27m once. Hedge and option claims are estimated at a separate rounded filing-implied stock price of $328.39, inferred from aggregate employee-option intrinsic value and exercise proceeds. It is not a verified closing quote and does not calibrate the conditional model. The base reference is $147.33 per share; conditional downcycle/base/upside values are $92.03 / $154.27 / $221.65 under the original operating cases and default assumptions.

固定市场参考完整保留12月观察到的936.27百万美元可转债报价一次。对冲及期权按申报文件中员工期权总内在价值及行权收入推算的约数股价328.39美元估计。这不是已验证的收盘价，也不用于校准条件模型。基准参考为每股147.33美元；原始营业情景及默认假设下，条件下行／基准／上行值为92.03／154.27／221.65美元。

Monte Carlo remains operating-EV only. The optional claims proxy is not repriced in each trial, and no common-share distribution is generated. A current capitalization roll-forward and contract/default-sensitive convertible engine are needed before claiming current or contract-complete fair value.

蒙特卡洛仍仅计算营业企业价值。可选索偿代理模型不在每次试验中重新定价，也不生成普通股分布。若要声称当前或完整合约公允价值，需要资本结构更新及反映合约／违约敏感性的可转债模型。
